scope: Read-only exact replay of fifth-pass training; no games rerun and no production source changes.
gate_delivery_order: Exact-key counts and witness were sent to game2048 and root before sixth-pass temporal source edits. This compact artifact was written afterward from those completed measurements.

source_references.core_part.py:266-305: Host receipts map actual traced source lines to generated association keys, union per decision, then average target over eligible decisions.
source_references.core_part.py:308-325: Choice byte intervals overlap non-newline bytes of actual executed lines; loop frequency is discarded.
source_references.core_part.py:427-433: Only continuation choices having more than one candidate are recorded for credit.
source_references.core_part.py:681-687: Each association receives one averaged target and one trial per completed observed episode.
source_references.code_memory_build.py:78-79: Anchor prior enters through strength times log(anchored_probability/local_probability).
Recent weight is the admitted-candidate unsmoothed Gini ratio; fewer than two recent successors returns exactly zero.
First and recent smoothed probabilities are mixed arithmetically before the existing log ratio.

replay_protocol.inputs: replica_00 and replica_01; legacy, uniform, advantage; initial.json and records/train/00000..00127.json
replay_protocol.generation: Load frozen bundle model and each initial state; generate with each recorded sample_seed in original order.
verification: Generated source equals recorded source exactly.
Replay original observe from recorded policy, episode, diagnostic, original receipt contract.
Resulting state fingerprint equals recorded state_after.
replay_protocol.eligibility: For each actual decision, call the frozen core _executed_choices(generated, set(executed_lines)); union tuple(choice[key]) once per decision.
replay_protocol.eligible_episode_key_pair: One key in the union of all actual decision key sets for one completed episode.
replay_protocol.dynamic_episode_key_pair: An eligible key missing from at least one decision; union minus intersection.
replay_protocol.dynamic_position_check: Repeat same construction for (byte_start, byte_end) instead of association key, to detect any loss caused by repeated keys.
replay_protocol.mean_dynamic_key_fraction: Unweighted mean across completed episodes of dynamic keys divided by eligible keys; zero for no dynamic keys.
replay_protocol.eligibility_patterns_histogram: Histogram of number of distinct per-decision association-key sets within each episode.
replay_protocol.centered_target: Q_i = sum(gamma**j * actual_gain[i+j]) / sum(gamma**j), j=0..min(8, remaining)-1; gamma=.9. Let m=mean(Q), d=max(abs(Q-m)). If d=0 targets equal terminal reward r; otherwise y_i=r+min(r,1-r)*(Q_i-m)/d.
replay_protocol.key_centered_delta: Mean y_i across decisions eligible for this key minus terminal episode reward r.
replay_protocol.mean_episode_max_absolute_centered_delta: Unweighted mean across completed episodes of maximum absolute key_centered_delta; zero when all keys are common.

witness.observed_semantics: The varying key is literal 2 in the score increment. This statement runs while scoring all legal candidate directions, including directions not ultimately selected. The final action=direction line21 has no recorded generation choice.

findings: The proposed centered target has nonzero association-level discrimination: 44 dynamic episode-key pairs across 40 completed episodes. Thus it does not collapse entirely to uniform feedback.
Most generated choice keys have identical eligibility on every actual decision; episode-centered targets give those common keys the same averaged credit as uniform episode targets.
Measured dynamic positions equal dynamic keys in all three arms, so repeated-key collision does not explain the reduction from varying source lines to varying choice keys in this sample.
Many varying executed lines are deterministic generation continuations, which generate() does not record as choices. Line coverage therefore overstates the available learned-credit distinction.
Executed-line eligibility does not distinguish an occurrence contributing to the selected action from occurrences scoring discarded candidates. The witness exposes this directly.

code_review.result: Approved fixed mathematical mechanism is implemented; no source edits requested by this review.
code_review.effective_prior_at_strength_one: Ignoring other score terms, local count exponent 1/.9 plus log(Panchor/Plocal) yields mass proportional to Plocal**(1/.9-1) * Panchor. The anchor nearly substitutes the local count prior.
code_review.sixth_mixture: Pmix=(1-alpha)*Pfirst+alpha*Precent, with independent pseudo-count2 smoothing; alpha=min(1,Gini_recent/Gini_first) on admitted unsmoothed counts, unary recent=>0, first Gini0 and recent positive=>1.
code_review.exact_guarantee: Unary recent admitted support returns exactly the original first-anchor distribution.

not_a_global_entropy_guarantee.conclusion: The soft mixture may still be sharper than the first prior; describe deterministic fallback and arithmetic mixing, not guaranteed preservation of all branch diversity.
